description: Helm charts, Kubernetes images, Python requirements, and GitHub Actions. Pull requests only: a merge deploys, so every update waits for the maintainer (docs/dependencies.md).

packageRules.description: Group minor and patch updates together for maintainer review.
Keep major updates separate and clearly labeled.
linuxserver.io tags look like version-4.0.20.3014: compare the four numbers, keep the digest pinned.
Longhorn and Argo CD can need upgrade steps (one Longhorn minor at a time; Argo CD's notes): their PRs say so.
prBodyNotes: Read the upgrade notes before merging: a merge deploys this. Longhorn upgrades one minor version at a time.
